_why: The words of the offline notice, in one place (Legal's RL-121 text, 2026-10-06; Legal may amend them). tools/build-site.mjs renders them as plain static HTML: no script, no external request, no tracking, no description or social meta, noindex. The working title is in the visible heading and the tab title only. Block kinds: h2 (a heading), p (a paragraph), small (a small paragraph), ul (a list of items).
title: Orb Combat EX (working title)

blocks.p: The whole planet is the arena. No walls, no corners, and a brawl choreographed around you.
A one-person project: Orb directs it and builds it with AI tools.

blocks.h2: The playable build is offline for now.

blocks.p: Our own automated check found some scenes that flash more often than the recommended limit of three times a second. We have taken the build down while we fix them. No independent photosensitivity analyser has been run. There is no date yet.

blocks.h2: Combos that build as you fight

blocks.p: No combo lists to memorise. Press a button, land a blow. The fight director is designed to chain your light, medium and heavy strikes into combos on the fly, shaped by where you stand and how the fight is going. No two exchanges are meant to play out the same way twice. The fight director is ordinary game code, not an AI model.
Planned: steer a flurry across the sky. Charge a heavy that shrugs off jabs. Aim a launcher with the stick. Fire point-blank energy. Zip past a rival's guard and out the other side.
No walls, no side to be cornered on. Fly one way and you come back round the other: city, desert, ocean, mountains. Planned: a sky that turns from noon to night as you cross it.

blocks.h2: Hit hard enough and it stays broken

blocks.p: Beams gouge trenches into the ground. Buildings crack and break apart in stages. The world keeps every scar until the match ends.

blocks.small: Features described here are in development and may change.

Orb Combat EX is a one-person project: Orb directs it and builds it with AI tools. AI tools wrote the game's code and drafted its art, animation data, dialogue, UI text and design documents. Its procedural systems (planets, fight choreography, the computer-controlled opponent) are ordinary code, not AI models.
This page collects and sends no personal data. It is hosted on GitHub Pages, which keeps its own server logs.
